verdict.rationale: Whether a developer platform's own source is available under an open license is a fair question for this kind of product, so the axis applies. Nothing in the evidence shows GitHub's platform source is published under an open license. The open-source GitHub CLI is a separate companion tool and earns no credit, and a community commenter describes GitHub as proprietary software.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can read the product's source under an open license
